apptrequired.title: Appointment Required
apptrequired.remarks: Indicates if an appointment is required for the job plan. Tasks that are created for this job plan inherit this value, but can be modified.

plusgcfwnum.title: Condition for Work
plusgcfwnum.remarks: The identifier of the condition for work.

aos.title: Requires Asset Downtime
aos.remarks: Indicates that the work cannot be performed while the asset is operating.

plusgassactivityimp.title: Assurance Activity Imported
plusgassactivityimp.remarks: Specifies whether the assurance activity was set by the user (value equals 0) or imported from an operating policy (value equals 1).

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The person group who will be responsible for the work order created with this job plan

lms.title: Requires Location Maintenance Window
lms.remarks: Indicates that the work must be performed during a dedicated maintenance window.

stconoffset.title: Start Constraint Offset
stconoffset.remarks: The amount of time (in hours) to be subtracted from the Target Start date in order to calculate the Start No Earlier Than date of the work record.

pluscstatusdate.title: Last status change date
pluscstatusdate.remarks: Displays the date the status was changed. This field is editable only on the Change Status dialog box.

flowaction.title: Flow Action
flowaction.remarks: The action to be performed (if any) when the workorder is started via process flow control

fnconoffset.title: Finish Constraint Offset
fnconoffset.remarks: The amount of time (in hours) to be added to the Target Finish date in order to calculate the Finish No Later Than date of the work record.

plusgimproveplan.title: Improvement Plan
plusgimproveplan.remarks: Specifies whether this job plan is an improvement plan that can be associated with an improvement record. If the check box is selected, this plan is an improvement plan.

modelid.title: Import ID
modelid.remarks: Import ID Typically from a BIM model or COBie data set.

plusglossunits.title: Loss Units
plusglossunits.remarks: The unit of measure, such as gallons, that is associated with this loss of production.

laborcode.title: Lead
laborcode.remarks: Defines the Lead person who will be copied to the work order created with this job plan

intshift.title: Interruptible shift
intshift.remarks: Work will be interrupted for only this shift in Graphical Scheduling application if value supplied. (Organization required)

plusgpolicyid.title: Operating Policy
plusgpolicyid.remarks: The unique identifier of an operating policy.

flowactionassist.title: Flow Action Assist
flowactionassist.remarks: Suppresses the automatic firing of the action in flow control

plusgauditid.title: Audit
plusgauditid.remarks: The audit that is associated with the job plan.

reqasstdwntime.title: Require Asset Downtime
reqasstdwntime.remarks: Indicates if the asset requires downtime while work is performed.

amcrew.title: Crew
amcrew.remarks: Defines the Crew who will be copied to the work order created with this job plan.

plusgriskassesscom.title: Comments
plusgriskassesscom.remarks: Comments about the risk assessment. You can change this value when the job plan record is in any status.

jpduration.title: Duration
jpduration.remarks: Duration Of Job Plan In Hours

plusgprofnum.title: Location Profile
plusgprofnum.remarks: The location profile that is associated with this job plan. The location profile contains information about production data. You can use location profiles to reduce the production losses that can result from planned or unplanned maintenance shutdowns. You can apply a system-level location profile to any job plan. You can apply an organization-level location profile to a job plan whose site belongs to the same organization as the location profile. You can apply a site-level location profile only to a job plan with the same site.

assignedownergroup.title: Assigned Owner Group
assignedownergroup.remarks: Identifies the owner group who will be responsible for the work order created with this job plan.  Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner group. You can enter a value either in this field or in the Owner field.

plusgprepphase.title: Phase
plusgprepphase.remarks: The phase of work, such as start-up, with which the preparation activities are associated.

los.title: Requires Location Downtime
los.remarks: Indicates that the work must be performed when the location is not in use, and available for maintenance.

calcmethod.title: Calculation
calcmethod.remarks: Calculation method; It could be STATIC, PROPORTIONAL, LEVEL or ATTRIBUTE

templatetype.title: Template Type
templatetype.remarks: Template Type of the Job Plan

crewworkgroup.title: Crew Work Group
crewworkgroup.remarks: Resource pool that will perform the work order.

crewid.title: Crew
crewid.remarks: ID for a given crew within a craft.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.remarks: Calendar to determine shift work is to be done on.

plusgriskassessid.title: Risk Assessment Unique Identifier
plusgriskassessid.remarks: The unique identifier of the risk assessment.

plusgriskasscat.title: Risk Assessment Requirement
plusgriskasscat.remarks: The category of the primary risk assessment that is associated with the job plan. Valid values are in the PLUSGRISKASSESSCAT domain.

interruptible.title: Interruptible
interruptible.remarks: Is this WO allowed to be stopped and restarted during resource scheduling

downtime.title: Downtime
downtime.remarks: Does the Asset have to be down for this WO?

plusgbennum.title: Loss Reference
plusgbennum.remarks: The loss (impact) record that defines the production loss or near miss that is associated with this job plan. The status of the impact record must be Active. The type of the impact record must be Loss, or the Benefit and Loss Apply flag on the impact record must be selected. You can apply a system-level loss to any job plan. You can apply an organization-level loss to a job plan whose site belongs to the same organization as the loss. You can apply a site-level loss only to a job plan with the same site.

plusglossquantity.title: Loss Quantity
plusglossquantity.remarks: The quantity of the loss. This field is used in conjunction with the Loss Units value.

pluscchangedate.title: Changed Date
pluscchangedate.remarks: Displays the date the status was changed. This field is editable only on the Change Status dialog box.

pluscrevnum.title: Revision
pluscrevnum.remarks: Displays the revision level of the current job plan.

calcapplyto.title: Type
calcapplyto.remarks: Calculation type : used to specify if the calculation update the duration or quantity value

pluscrevcom.title: Description
pluscrevcom.remarks: Enter the reason for the change. This field is editable only when the revision is first created.

plusgscenario.title: Scenario
plusgscenario.remarks: The scenario that is associated with the preparation activities.

plusdregstandard.title: Regulatory Standard
plusdregstandard.remarks: The regulatory standard that is applicable to this record. For example, North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC).

dynamic.title: Is dynamic
dynamic.remarks: Flag used to hide or display dynamic fields

plusgassactivity.title: Assurance Activity
plusgassactivity.remarks: Specifies whether the job plan implements an assurance activity. If this check box is selected, an assurance activity is implemented.

suspendflow.title: Suspend Flow Control
suspendflow.remarks: Flag used to suspend and resume flow control on a parent record.

plusgauditnum.title: Audit
plusgauditnum.remarks: The audit that is associated with the job plan.

repairlocflag.title: Repair Facility Required
repairlocflag.remarks: Indicates whether the repair location is required.

pluscchangeby.title: Changed By
pluscchangeby.remarks: Displays the user name of the person logged in when the job plan was created or changed.

plusgoutageconseq.title: Outage Consequence
plusgoutageconseq.remarks: The potential impact on production if there is an outage that might be associated with this job plan.

plusgprepref.title: Reference
plusgprepref.remarks: The reference to the work package that is associated with the preparation activities. If you use a project management system, you can reference the task identifier.

plusgprepactiv.title: Preparation Activity
plusgprepactiv.remarks: Indicates whether the job plan is associated with preparation activities

inctasksinsched.title: Include Tasks in Schedule
inctasksinsched.remarks: Indicates that tasks of records created from this job plan will be included in the schedule view.

flowcontrolled.title: Flow Controlled
flowcontrolled.remarks: Flag used to indicate a records participation in flow control.

ams.title: Requires Asset Maintenance Window
ams.remarks: Indicates that the work must be performed during a dedicated maintenance window.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: One Line Short Description Of Job Plan

plusgworkbreak.title: Work Breakdown Structure
plusgworkbreak.remarks: The reference to the work breakdown structure or to the work package number that is associated with the preparation activities. If you use a project management system, you can specify the work breakdown structure from that system.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: The person who will be responsible for the work order created with this job plan

plusgpreptype.title: Type of Preparation
plusgpreptype.remarks: The type of activity that is associated with the preparation activities.

applynondynamiccalc.title: Ignore linear measures
applynondynamiccalc.remarks: If the work order asset is a linear one, and that check box is checked, the TWU will not be calculated but entered by user

plusglocprofid.title: Location Profile
plusglocprofid.remarks: The location profile that is associated with this job plan record. The location profile contains information about production data. You can use location profiles to reduce the production losses that can result from planned or unplanned maintenance shutdowns.

milestone.title: Is Milestone
milestone.remarks: Indicates if this job plan is a milestone.

hasnestedjp.title: Nested Job Plans
hasnestedjp.remarks: Indicates if this Job Plan has nested Job Plans.

inspformnum.title: Inspection Form
inspformnum.remarks: The number of the inspection form.
